_meta.endpoint_note: gateway.tenderly.co/public/mainnet -- the only keyless log source with no block-range cap. publicnode refuses eth_getLogs entirely; eth.drpc.org works but caps at 10,000 blocks per request. See rpc_errors.json.
_meta.block_range_note: FULL protocol history: deploy block 25546793 -> 25612716 (the research end block). One request, no pagination needed.
_meta.note: 70 events all-time. Existence of updateBacking(uint256,uint256) refutes the 'backing is immutable for a listing's life' claim (§12.1). Each event changes a position's weight, so a cached position snapshot must invalidate on these.
_meta.raw_body_note: Raw log array lives at response.result (the untouched JSON-RPC body). It is deliberately NOT duplicated at a top-level 'logs' key.
